## 7. Telephone normalization

```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request) throws InvalidTelephoneException {
    String e164 = E164PhoneNumber.toE164(request.getTelephone())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new InvalidTelephoneException(request.getTelephone()));
    request.setTelephone(e164);
}
```

The actual normalization algorithm is in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/E164PhoneNumber.java`:
- `toE164(String raw)` → `Optional<String>`: trims, strips spaces/dashes/brackets; if input starts with `+`, keeps the country code; otherwise assumes default country code `61` (Australia) and drops a single leading `0`; validates against `\+[0-9]{8,15}`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:

## Summary

I consolidated all owner duplicate detection into a single derived `identityKey` = `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId`, rejecting with 409 only on a whole-key match.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner.java`** — added a derived `getIdentityKey()` getter, alongside the existing derived getters (`getLocality`, `getMembershipLevel`, `getContactPreference`). It joins the normalized telephone, email (empty when absent), and household id (empty when none) with `|`. Never persisted.

2. **`EnsureUniqueIdentityKey.java`** (new function class) — the single duplicate check. It narrows candidates via `findByTelephone` (every equal key necessarily shares the telephone, since it's the key's first segment), then rejects only when a candidate's *whole* `getIdentityKey()` matches. Throws the new checked `DuplicateIdentityKeyException`.

3. **`DuplicateIdentityKeyException` + handler + escalation YAML** (new) — mirror the existing escalation pattern, responding 409 via `ProblemDetails`.

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — removed the `ensureUniqueTelephone`, `ensureUniqueHousehold`, and `ensureUniqueEmail` steps; inserted `ensureUniqueIdentityKey` after `assignHouseholdId` (so telephone/email are normalized and the household id is assigned before the key is derived) and before `save`.

5. **`openapi.yml`** — added the readOnly `identityKey` property to the `Owner` response schema, so the regenerated `OwnerDto` returns it (MapStruct maps it by name automatically).

6. **Deleted** the three obsolete `EnsureUnique*` function classes, three `Duplicate*Exception` classes, three handlers, and three escalation YAMLs — no dead code left behind. The `Households` helper stays (still used by `AssignHouseholdId`), and I fixed a stale `@link` in `NormalizeOwnerTelephone`.

**Behaviour change, as specified:** because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones now have different identity keys and are both allowed — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate. The acceptance test `coreRejectsIdentityCollision` (two owners differing only in telephone-collision → 409) passes, and `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` / `BUILD SUCCESS`.
